Definition: from G935; to rule (literally or figuratively):--king, reign.
BiblicalUsage: Basileuo means to reign, to rule as a king. Gabriel says the Son will reign over the house of Jacob forever, Paul says Christ must reign until He has put all enemies under His feet, that those who receive grace will reign in life through Jesus Christ, and John hears that the Lord God omnipotent reigns.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe reigning is the promise that makes every other promise sure, because a King who reigns forever cannot lose what He has won. Death reigned through Adam, grace reigns through Christ, and I hold that the reign of Jesus is the one reign that will never end.
